subject.title: Feature: --agent flag for TUI to select which agent handles the session

question: Should the TUI add `--agent <id>` as a first-class ergonomic selector even though canonical `--session agent:<id>:<key>` values and workspace inference already provide agent routing?
rationale: The underlying routing capability exists; the unresolved question is whether OpenClaw should support another public CLI selector and what its compatibility contract should be.

options.title: Add ergonomic selector
options.body: Add `--agent <id>`, canonicalize it through existing session routing, and reject conflicting agent-scoped session values.

options.title: Keep one selector
options.body: Retain agent-scoped `--session` as the sole explicit startup contract and improve its discoverability in help and documentation.

recommendation.title: Add ergonomic selector
recommendation.body: Add `--agent <id>`, canonicalize it through existing session routing, and reject conflicting agent-scoped session values.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior item-specific review and recent TUI history make this the strongest available owner for the public CLI direction.
